title: miscanthus sinensis f. gracillimus
intro: Miscanthus sinensis f. gracillimus, commonly known as Zebra Grass, is a variety of ornamental grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is known for its striking yellow and green striped foliage and its ability to thrive in a variety of conditions. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate stress. The bioactive constituents of Zebra Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties.
